name: web-chat-tour
description: Onboarding only — the first-run tour the CLI mounts before Claude Code has restarted. Do NOT pick this for general rendering. Params: {role:'guide'|'mirror', root, channel_connected}. Writes tour_scratch (scratch) and web_chat_init (declared signal, {seq, done, choice, note}). When you see web_chat_init, clear mounts 'web-chat-tour' and 'web-chat-tour-mirror' as your first act.
